function.name: get_available_reagents

function.name: mix_two_solutions

sol2_vol.description: volume of the second solution to draw

function.name: add_a_solution
function.description: Adds a specific volume of `sol2_label` to all of `sol1_label` and returns observations about the changes of solution color and precipitation amount and color.

sol2_vol.description: volume of the second solution to draw

function.name: filter_solution
function.description: Separates the precipitate from the supernatant solution.

function.name: add_precipitate_to_solution
function.description: Adds a precipitate to a specific volume of a solution and returns observations about the changes in the amount/color of the added precipitate or the solution color.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Returns the current contents of the Inventory
